definitions.explanation: A person who works diligently and tirelessly. A complimentary term for someone who puts in great effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{働|はたら}き{者|もの}だ。
うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{働|はたら}き{者|もの}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だった。
examples.english: My grandmother was famous for being a hard worker since long ago.

examples.japanese: ミツバチ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自然界|しぜんかい}→自然界：15255_shizenkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{知|し}られた→知る：00458_shiru⟧{働|はたら}き{者|もの}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Honeybees are said to be the most well-known hard workers in the natural world.

notes:
{働|はたら}き{者|もの} is a positive term for someone who works hard and diligently. It can also be used for animals (e.g., bees, ants).

FORMS:
⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧ (stem of ⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧, to work) + ⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧ (person characterized by)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {働|はたら}き{者|もの}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧: known as a hard worker
- {働|はたら}き{者|もの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧: she, the hard worker

SIMILAR ～{者|もの} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{怠|なま}け{者|もの}→怠け者：16970_namakemono⟧: lazy person (opposite)
- ⟦{頑張|がんば}り→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: person who tries hard (uses ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ suffix instead)
- ⟦{努力家|どりょくか}→努力家：22284_doryokuka⟧: hard-working person (more formal)

REGISTER:
A warm, approving word often used in everyday conversation. It carries a sense of admiration, particularly for steady, persistent effort rather than flashy achievement.
